title: TruckeeVibes events API v1
description: Response of GET https://truckeevibes.com/api/v1/events. Additive changes only within v1; a breaking change ships as /api/v2.

scope.description: vibes = the TruckeeVibes list; lights = the events shown on Truckee Lights / Truckee Frights for one season.

year.description: The season's December year (scope=lights), else null.

dataAt.description: When the database produced this page (UTC).

stale.description: Always false in v1: there is no stale fallback (an outage is a 503). Kept so clients can keep checking it.

pageComplete.description: true when this is the last page (nextCursor is null).

mirror.description: Freshness of the Truckee Lights mirror (scope=lights). Always state none for scope=vibes.

state.description: confirmed = the last read matched; held = a large removal is waiting for review.

confirmedAt.description: Time of the last confirmed mirror read.

heldSince.description: When the held removal was first seen.

tz.description: IANA time zone for local dates.

localBox.description: Bounding box of the local area.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor= for the next page; null on the last page.

attribution.description: Credit line to show with the data.

events.description: Events ordered by start time, then id.

id.description: Stable event id (a Truckee Lights id for origin=lights).

formerIds.description: Ids of events merged into this one (up to 5 hops).

pageUrl.description: The event's TruckeeVibes page, when it has one.

description.description: Organizer text; only on origin=lights rows.

summary.description: Our one-line summary; only on origin=vibes rows.

endsAt.description: End (UTC), when known. All-day events end at local midnight after the last day.

startDate.description: First local day of an all-day event.

endDate.description: Day after the last local day of an all-day event (exclusive).

timeKnown.description: false when the source gave a date but no time.

url.description: The organizer's page for the event.
